nodes.name: Open the dashboard
nodes.notes: Served by n8n, not Netlify — see the README.

nodes.name: Bookings
nodes.notes: Thirty days back as well as forward: the page needs recent history to show what was cancelled and what has been done, not just what is next.

nodes.name: Invoices
nodes.notes: Filtered by month in code rather than in a Xero where clause — one fewer piece of syntax to get wrong, and the volume is tiny.

nodes.name: Next payout
nodes.notes: What actually lands in Starling, and when. Revenue and cash are not the same number.

nodes.name: Last deploy
nodes.notes: Public repository, so no token needed. Tells the page whether the last push to main actually deployed.

nodes.name: Build the page
nodes.notes: Every value is read through a helper that tolerates a missing field, so one misbehaving system leaves a gap on the page instead of a blank screen.
